description_en: Registers media assets. If you have existing media asset files stored in your own OSS buckets integrated with ApsaraVideo VOD, you must register the media assets to generate the associated data required by ApsaraVideo VOD before you can use features such as transcoding and snapshot generation
description_zh: 进行媒资注册，接入点播服务的OSS自有Bucket上的存量媒资文件，需要进行媒资注册生成点播需要的关联数据后，才能正常使用点播提供的转码、截图等功能
name: RegisterMedia

parameters.help_en: The metadata of the media assets to be registered. The value is a JSON string. You can specify the metadata for up to 10 media assets at a time. For more information about the parameter structure, see the RegisterMetadata table below
parameters.help_zh: 注册媒资元数据。为JSON字符串，一次最多支持设置10个媒资元数据。参数结构的更多信息，请参见下表RegisterMetadata
parameters.name: register_metadatas

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the transcoding template group. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
Log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Configuration Management > Media Processing Configuration > Transcoding Template Groups to view the ID of the transcoding template group.
When you create a transcoding template group by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102665.html operation, the ID of the transcoding template group is the value of the TranscodeTemplateGroupId response parameter.
When you query transcoding template groups by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102669.html operation, the ID of the transcoding template group is the value of the TranscodeTemplateGroupId response parameter.

If transcoding is not required, set this parameter to VOD_NO_TRANSCODE, which specifies the no-transcoding template group. Otherwise, the video status is Upload Completed, and you cannot use the playback service to play the audio or video. If transcoding is required, specify the ID of the corresponding transcoding template group.
If both WorkflowId and TemplateGroupId are specified, WorkflowId takes precedence. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115347.html.
The task for this parameter is an https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3027551.html. After the task is submitted, it is not immediately completed but queued for asynchronous execution in the background
parameters.help_zh:
转码模板组ID。可通过以下方式获取：
登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择配置管理 > 媒体处理配置 > 转码模板组查看转码模版组ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102665.html接口创建转码模板组时，转码模板组ID为返回参数TranscodeTemplateGroupId的值。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102669.html接口查询转码模板组时，为请求后返回参数TranscodeTemplateGroupId的值。

如果不需要转码，请指定为VOD_NO_TRANSCODE（不转码模板组），否则视频状态会为上传完成，从而无法使用播放服务播放音视频。如果需要转码，则指定对应转码模板组ID。
如果同时传递了WorkflowId和TemplateGroupId，以WorkflowId为准。使用说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115347.html。
该参数任务为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3027551.html，提交后任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行
parameters.name: template_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The custom settings. The value is a JSON string. You can configure settings such as message callbacks. For more information about the parameter, see [UserData](~~86952#section_6fg_qll_v3w~~).
This operation does not support callbacks. Even if a message callback is configured in this parameter, no callback message is generated after the media asset registration is completed. When you subsequently initiate media processing such as transcoding and snapshot generation for the registered media assets, if you separately configure a message callback in UserData when initiating the transcoding or snapshot generation, that callback URL takes precedence. If no callback is separately configured, the callback URL configured in UserData during the media asset registration is used
parameters.help_zh:
自定义设置。为JSON字符串，支持消息回调等设置。参数详情，请参见[UserData](~~86952#section_6fg_qll_v3w~~)。
本接口不支持回调，即便此参数中设置了消息回调，在媒资注册完成后也不会产生回调消息。当后续对注册完成的媒资发起转码、截图等媒体处理时，若在发起转码、截图时单独设置了UserData中的消息回调，则优先使用那个回调地址；未设置，则使用此处注册媒资时UserData中设置的回调地址
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the media workflow. You can log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Configuration Management > Media Processing Configuration > Workflow Management to view the workflow ID.

If both WorkflowId and TemplateGroupId are specified, WorkflowId takes precedence. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115347.html.
The task for this parameter is an https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3027551.html. After the task is submitted, it is not immediately completed but queued for asynchronous execution in the background
parameters.help_zh:
工作流ID。可登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择配置管理 > 媒体处理配置 > 工作流管理查看工作流ID。

如果同时传递了WorkflowId和TemplateGroupId，以WorkflowId为准。使用说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115347.html。
该参数任务为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3027551.html，提交后任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行
parameters.name: workflow_id
